name: Invasion of Chaos Booster Pack (25th Anniversary Edition)
cleanName: Invasion of Chaos Booster Pack 25th Anniversary Edition
extDescription:
For years, you could only get your hands on these coveted packs as part of the Legendary Collection, but now, just in time to celebrate the 25th anniversary of the card game, they’re being made available as a standalone booster!

Invasion of Chaos unleashed a variety of powerful cards that rewarded Duelists who packed their Decks with LIGHT and DARK Attribute monsters. The legendary Black Luster Soldier – Envoy of the Beginning and Chaos Emperor Dragon – Envoy of the End dominated Duels and the Spell-retrieving Dark Magician of Chaos joined them thanks to the incredibly powerful Dimension Fusion Spell Card! This printing will feature both Secret Rares from the set.

Each Invasion of Chaos Booster Pack (25th Anniversary Edition) contains 9 cards.

name: Chaos Emperor Dragon - Envoy of the End
cleanName: Chaos Emperor Dragon Envoy of the End
extDescription: Effect: This card can only be Special Summoned by removing 1 LIGHT and 1 DARK monster in your Graveyard from play. Pay 1000 of your Life Points to send all cards in both players' hands and on the field to the Graveyard. Inflict 300 points of damage to your opponent's Life Points for each card that is sent to the Graveyard by this effect.

name: Ojama Yellow
extDescription: He's one of the Ojama Trio. It's said that he butts in by any means necessary. It's also said that when the three are together, something happens.

name: Ojama Black
extDescription: He's one of the Ojama Trio. It's said that he butts in by any means necessary. It's also said that when the three are together, something happens.

name: Soul Tiger

name: Big Koala

name: Des Kangaroo

name: Crimson Ninja

name: Strike Ninja

name: Gale Lizard

name: Spirit of the Pot of Greed

name: Chopman the Desperate Outlaw
extDescription: Effect: When this card is Flip Summoned successfully, you can equip 1 Equip Spell Card in your Graveyard to this card.

name: Sasuke Samurai #3

name: D.D. Scout Plane

name: Berserk Gorilla
extDescription: Effect: If this card is in face-up Defense Position on the field, destroy this card. The controller of this card must attack with this card when possible.

name: Freed the Brave Wanderer
extDescription: Effect: Remove 2 LIGHT monsters in your Graveyard from play to destroy 1 face-up monster on the field with higher ATK than this card. You can only use this effect once per turn.

name: Coach Goblin
extDescription: Effect: As long as this card remains face-up on your side of the field, you can return 1 Normal Monster Card in your hand to the bottom of your Deck during your End Phase to draw 1 card from your Deck. You can only use this effect once per turn.

name: Witch Doctor of Chaos
extDescription: FLIP: Select 1 Monster Card from you or your opponent's Graveyard. Remove it from play.

name: Chaos Necromancer
extDescription: Effect: The ATK of this card becomes the number of Monster Cards in your Graveyard x 300 points.

extDescription: Effect: You can remove up to 2 Spell Cards in your Graveyard from play to increase the ATK of this monster by 300 points for each card removed from play until the end of your opponent's next turn. This effect can only be used once during your turn.

name: Inferno
extDescription: Effect: This card can only be Special Summoned by removing 1 FIRE monster in your Graveyard from play. When this card destroys an opponent's monster and sends it to the Graveyard as a result of battle, inflict 1500 points of damage to your opponent's Life Points.

name: Fenrir
extDescription: Effect: This card can only be Special Summoned by removing 2 WATER monsters in your Graveyard from play. When this card destroys an opponent's monster as a result of battle, your opponent skips his/her next Draw Phase.

name: Gigantes
extDescription: Effect: This card can only be Special Summoned by removing 1 EARTH monster in your Graveyard from play. When this card is destroyed and sent to the Graveyard as a result of battle, destroy all Spell and Trap Cards on the field.

name: Silpheed
extDescription: Effect: This card can only be Special Summoned by removing 1 WIND monster in your Graveyard from play. When this card is destroyed and sent to the Graveyard as a result of battle, your opponent discards 1 card randomly from his/her hand.

name: Chaos Sorcerer
extDescription: Effect: This card can only be Special Summoned by removing 1 LIGHT and 1 DARK monster in your Graveyard from play. Once during each of your turns, you can remove 1 face-up monster on the field from play. If you activate this effect, this card cannot attack during this turn.

name: Gren Maju Da Eiza
extDescription: Effect: The ATK and DEF of this card become the number of your cards removed from play x 400 points.

name: Black Luster Soldier - Envoy of the Beginning
cleanName: Black Luster Soldier Envoy of the Beginning
extDescription:
Cannot be Normal Summoned/Set. This card can only be Special Summoned (from your hand) by banishing 1 LIGHT and 1 DARK monster from your GY. Once per turn, you can activate 1 of these effects:
• Target 1 monster on the field; banish it. This card cannot attack the turn this effect is activated.
• If this attacking card destroys an opponent's monster by battle: it can make a second attack in a row.

name: Drillago
extDescription: If the only cards on your opponent's side of the field are face-up monsters with ATK 1600 or more, this monster can attack your opponent's Life Points directly.

name: Lekunga
extDescription: Effect: Remove 2 WATER monsters in your Graveyard from play to Special Summon 1 "Lekunga Token" (Plant-Type/WATER/2 Stars/ATK 700/DEF 700) in Attack Position on your side of the field.

name: Lord Poison
extDescription: Effect: Then this card is destroyed and sent to the Graveyard as a result of battle, Special Summon 1 Plant-Type monster in your Graveyard except "Lord Poison" on your side of the field.

name: Bowganian
extDescription: Effect: During each of your Standby Phases, inflict 600 points of damage to your opponent's Life Points.

name: Granadora
extDescription: Effect: When this monster is Normal Summoned, Flip Summoned, or Special Summoned successfully, increase your Life Points by 1000 points. When this card is destroyed and sent to the Graveyard, you take 2000 points of damage.

name: Fuhma Shuriken
extDescription: You can only equip this card to a monster that includes "Ninja" in its card name. Increase the ATK of the equipped monster by 700 points. When this card is sent from the field to the Graveyard, inflict 700 points of damage to your opponent's Life Points.

name: Heart of the Underdog
extDescription: During your Draw Phase, if the card you draw is a Normal Monster Card, you can draw 1 more card by showing the card to your opponent.

name: Wild Nature's Release
extDescription: Increase the ATK of 1 face-up Beast-Type or Beast-Warrior-Type Monster on the field by an amount equal to its DEF. Destroy the monster during the End Phase.

name: Ojama Delta Hurricane!!
extDescription: You can only activate this card when "Ojama Green", "Ojama Yellow" and "Ojama Black" are face-up on your side of the field, Destroy all cards on your opponent's side of the field.

name: Stumbling
extDescription: As long as this card remains face-up on the field, any monster that is Normal Summoned, Flip Summoned or Special Summoned successfully is changed to Defense Position.

name: Chaos End
extDescription: You can only activate this card when 7 or more of your cards are removed from play. Destroy all Monster Cards on the field.

name: Yellow Luster Shield
extDescription: Increase the DEF of all monsters on your side of the field by 300 points.

name: Chaos Greed
extDescription: You can only activate this card when 4 or more of your cards are removed from play and there are no cards in your Graveyard. Draw 2 cards from your Deck.

name: D.D. Designator
extDescription: Declare 1 card name. Look at your opponent's hand, and if he/she has declared card in his/her hand, remove that 1 card from play. If he/she doesn't have the declared card in his/her hand, remove 1 random card in your hand from play.

name: D.D. Borderline
extDescription: While there are no Spell Cards in your Graveyard, neither player can conduct their Battle Phase.

name: Recycle
extDescription: During your Standby Phase, pay 300 Life Points to select 1 non-Monster Card in your Graveyard and return it to the bottom of your Deck.

name: Primal Seed
extDescription: You can only activate this card when there is a "Black Luster Soldier - Envoy of the Beginning" or "Chaos Emperor Dragon - Envoy of the End" on the field. Add 2 of your cards that are removed from play to your hand.

name: Thunder Crash
extDescription: Destroy all monsters you control, and if you do, inflict 300 damage to your opponent for each monster destroyed.

name: Dimension Distortion
extDescription: You can only activate this card when there are no cards in your Graveyard. Select 1 monster that is removed from play and Special Summon it on your side of the field.

name: Reload
extDescription: Add all cards in your hand to your Deck and shuffle it. Then draw the same number of cards that you added to your deck.

name: Soul Absorption
extDescription: Each time a card is removed from play, the controller of this card increases his/her Life Points by 500 points.

name: Big Burn
extDescription: You can only activate this card when your opponent activates a card that specifically designates a monster in the Graveyard as a target. Remove all monsters in both players' Graveyards from play.

name: Blasting the Ruins
extDescription: You can only activate this card if there are 30 or more cards in your Graveyard. Inflict 3000 points of damage to your opponent's Life Points.

name: Cursed Seal of the Forbidden Spell
cleanName: Cursed Seal of the Forbidden Spell
extDescription: Discard 1 Spell Card from your hand to negate the activation and the effect of a Spell Card and destroy it. Your opponent cannot activate Spell Cards of the same name (including the Spell Card that is destroyed by this card's effect) during the rest of the Duel.

name: Tower of Babel
extDescription: Each time you or your opponent activates a Spell Card, put 1 Spell Counter on this card. When the 4th Spell Counter is put on this card, destroy this card and inflict 3000 points of damage to the player that activated the Spell Card at that time.

name: Spatial Collapse
extDescription: You can only activate this card when both you and your opponent each have 5 or less cards on the field. As long as this card remains face-up on the field, the total number of cards that each player can have on the field is 5.

name: Chain Disappearance
extDescription: You can only activate this card when a monster with an ATK of 1000 or less is Normal Summoned, Flip Summoned or Special Summoned. Remove the monster from play and your opponent removes all monsters of the same name in his/her hand and Deck from play. His/her Deck is then shuffled.

name: Zero Gravity
extDescription: Change the battle positions of all face-up monsters on you and your opponent's sides of the field.

name: Dark Mirror Force
extDescription: You can only activate this card when your opponent's monster declares an attack. Remove from play all monsters in Defense Position on your opponent's side of the field.

name: Energy Drain
extDescription: Select 1 face-up monster on your side of the field. Increase the ATK and DEF of the monster by an amount equal to the number of cards in your opponent's hand x 200 points until the End Phase.

name: Giga Gagagigo
extDescription: In order to fight tremendous evil, he gained formidable power through body reconstruction, but lost his heart and his redemption.

name: Mad Dog of Darkness
extDescription: He used to be a normal dog who played around in a park, but was corrupted by the powers of darkness.

name: Neo Bug
extDescription: A huge bug-like monster said to come from another planet. It gathers in swarms.

name: Terrorking Salmon
extDescription: A feared salmon, master of the Sea of Darkness. Its roe is the best delicacy in the World of Darkness.

name: Blazing Inpachi
extDescription: A wicked wooden spirit now burning in flames. Its fire attack is powerful, but it will soon be nothing but ashes.

name: Burning Algae
extDescription: When this card is sent to the Graveyard, increase your opponent's Life Points by 1000 points.

name: The Thing in the Crater
extDescription: When this card is destroyed and sent from the field to the Graveyard, you can Special Summon 1 Pyro-Type Monster from your hand.

name: Molten Zombie
extDescription: When this card is Special Summoned from the Graveyard, the controller of this card draws 1 card.

name: Dark Magician of Chaos
extDescription: During the End Phase, if this card was Normal or Special Summoned this turn: You can target 1 Spell in your GY; add it to your hand. You can only use this effect of "Dark Magician of Chaos" once per turn. If this card destroys an opponent's monster by battle, after damage calculation: Banish that opponent's monster. If this face-up card would leave the field, banish it instead.

name: Gora Turtle of Illusion
extDescription: Negate the effect of Spell and Trap Cards controlled by your opponent that specifically designate this face-up card on the field as a target.

name: Manticore of Darkness
extDescription: During the End Phase of the turn this card is sent to the Graveyard, send 1 Beast, Beast-Warrior or Winged Beast-Type Monster Card from your hand or your side of the field to the Graveyard to Special Summon this card from the Graveyard.

name: Stealth Bird
extDescription: You can flip this card into face-down Defense Position once per turn during your Main Phase. When this card is Flip Summoned successfully, inflict 1000 points of damage to your opponent's Life Points.

name: Sacred Crane
extDescription: When this card is Special Summoned, the controller of this card draws 1 card.

name: Enraged Battle Ox
extDescription: As long as this card remains face-up on your side of the field, when Beast, Beast-Warrior and Winged Beast-Type monsters on your side of the field attack with an ATK that is higher than the DEF of your opponent's Defense Position monster, inflict the difference as Battle Damage to your opponent's Life Points.

name: Don Turtle
extDescription: When this card is Normal Summoned or Flip Summoned successfully, you can Special Summon any number of "Don Turtle"(s) from your hand.

name: Balloon Lizard
extDescription: Put 1 counter on this card during each of your Standby Phases. When this card is destroyed, inflict damage equal to the number of counters x 400 points to the controller of the card that destroyed this card.

name: Dark Driceratops
extDescription: When this card attacks with an ATK that is higher than the DEF of your opponent's Defense Position monster, inflict the difference as Battle Damage to your opponent's Life Points.

name: Hyper Hammerhead
extDescription: When this monster battles an opponent's monster, if the opponent's monster is not destroyed as a result of the battle, the opponent's monster is returned to its owner's hand at the end of the Damage Step.

name: Black Tyranno
extDescription: If the only cards your opponent controls are Defense Position monsters, this card can attack directly.

name: Anti-Aircraft Flower
extDescription: Offer 1 Insect-Type monster on your side of the field as a Tribute to inflict 800 points of damage to your opponent's Life Points.

name: Prickle Fairy
extDescription: Your opponent cannot attack Insect-Type monsters unless he/she destroys this card first. The Battle Position of a monster that battles with this card is changed to Defense Position at the end of the Damage Step.

name: Pinch Hopper
extDescription: When this card on your side of the field is sent to the Graveyard, you can Special Summon 1 Insect-Type Monster from your hand.

name: Skull-Mark Ladybug
extDescription: When this card is sent to the Graveyard, increase your Life Points by 1000 points.

name: Insect Princess
extDescription: While this card is face-up on the field, battle positions of all face-up Insect-Type monsters on your opponent's side of the field are changed into Attack Position. Each time this card destroys and Insect-Type monster in battle, increase the ATK of this card by 500 points.

name: Amphibious Bugroth Mk-3
extDescription: As long as "Umi" remains face-up on the field, this card can attack your opponent's Life Points directly.

name: Torpedo Fish
extDescription: While "Umi" is face-up on the field, this card is unaffected by any Spell Cards.

name: Levia-Dragon - Daedalus
extDescription: You can send 1 face-up "Umi" you control to the GY; destroy all other cards on the field.

name: Orca Mega-Fortress of Darkness
extDescription: By tributing 1 "Torpedo Fish" on your side of the field, destroy 1 monster on the field. By tributing 1 "Cannonball Spear Shellfish" on your side of the field, destroy 1 Spell or Trap Card on the field.

name: Cannonball Spear Shellfish
extDescription: As long as "Umi" remains face-up on the field, this card is unaffected by any Spell Cards.

name: Mataza the Zapper
extDescription: This monster can attack twice during the same Battle Phase. As long as this card remains face-up on the field, control of this card cannot switch.

name: Guardian Angel Joan
extDescription: When this card destroys a monster and sends it to the Graveyard as a result of battle, increase your Life Points by an amount equal to the original ATK of the destroyed monster.

name: Manju of the Ten Thousand Hands
cleanName: Manju of the Ten Thousand Hands
extDescription: When this card is Normal or Flip Summoned: You can add 1 Ritual Monster or 1 Ritual Spell from your Deck to your hand.

name: Getsu Fuhma
extDescription: If a monster that battles with this monster is a Fiend or Zombie-Type monster, destroy that monster at the end of the Damage Step.

name: Ryu Kokki
extDescription: If a monster that battles with this monster is a Warrior or Spellcaster-Type monster, destroy that monster at the end of the Damage Step.

name: Gryphon's Feather Duster
extDescription: Destroy all Spell and Trap Cards on your side of the field. Increase your Life Points by the number of destroyed cards x 500 points.

name: Stray Lambs
extDescription: If you activate this card, you cannot Normal Summon, Flip Summon or Special Summon during this turn. Special Summon 2 "Lamb Tokens" (Beast-Type/EARTH/1 Star/ATK 0/DEF 0) in Defense Position on your side of the field.

name: Smashing Ground
extDescription: Destroy 1 monster with the highest DEF on your opponent's side of the field.

name: Dimension Fusion
extDescription: Pay 2000 Life Points. Both players Special Summon as many of their removed from play monsters as possible.

name: Dedication Through Light and Darkness
extDescription: You can only activate this card by offering "Dark Magician" on your side of the field as a Tribute. Select 1 "Dark Magician of Chaos" from your hand, your Graveyard or your Deck and Special Summon it.

name: Salvage
extDescription: Add 2 WATER monsters with an ATK of 1500 or less in each Graveyard to your hand.

name: Ultra Evolution Pill
extDescription: Tribute 1 Reptile-Type monster on your side of the field. Special Summon 1 Dinosaur-Type Monster from your hand.

name: Multiplication of Ants
extDescription: Tribute 1 Insect-Type Monster on your side of the field. Special Summon 2 "Army Ant Tokens" (Insect-Type/EARTH/4 Stars/ATK 500/DEF 1200) on your side of the field. The tokens cannot be used as a Tribute for a Tribute Summon.

name: Earth Chant
extDescription: This card is used to Ritual Summon any EARTH monster. You must also offer monsters from the field or your hand whose total Level Stars equal the Level Stars of the Ritual Monster you are attempting to Ritual Summon.

name: Jade Insect Whistle
extDescription: Your opponent selects 1 Insect-Type Monster from his/her Deck. After shuffling the Deck, place the card on top of the Deck.

name: Destruction Ring
extDescription: Destroy 1 face-up monster on your side of the field to inflict 1000 points of damage to both players' Life Points.

name: Fiend's Hand Mirror
extDescription: Switch the opponent's Spell Card effect that specifically designates 1 Spell or Trap Card as a target to another correct target.

name: Compulsory Evacuation Device
extDescription: Return 1 monster on the field to its owner's hand.

name: A Hero Emerges
extDescription: You can only activate this card when your opponent declares an attack. Select 1 random card from your hand. If it is a Monster Card, Special Summon it on your side of the field. If not, send it to the Graveyard.

name: Self-Destruct Button
extDescription: You can activate this card when your Life Points are lower than your opponent's Life Points and the difference is 7000 points or more. Both player's Life Points become 0.

name: Curse of Darkness
extDescription: Each time a Spell Card is activated, the controller of that Spell Card takes 1000 points of damage.

name: Begone, Knave!
extDescription: If a monster inflicts Battle Damage to a player, return the monster to its owner's hand.

name: DNA Transplant
extDescription: Declare 1 Attribute when you activate this card. As long as this card remains face-up on the field, the Attribute of all face-up monsters on the field becomes the one you declared.

name: Robbin' Zombie
extDescription: Each time 1 monster on your side of the field inflicts Battle Damage to your opponent's Life Points, your opponent sends 1 card from the top of his/her Deck to the Graveyard.

name: Trap Jammer
extDescription: You can only activate this card when your opponent activates a Trap Card during the Battle Phase. Negate the activation of the Trap Card and destroy it.

name: Invader of Darkness
extDescription: While this card remains face-up on the field, your opponent cannot activate Quick-Play Spell Cards.
